description: One tool for 3,607 app capabilities (n8n catalog + OpenAPI + MCP): say what should happen; get the exact call. Plain words in ('send an sms to +1 213 555 0100 saying hello', 'add a row to google sheets'); the matching capability is found, its required inputs are checked (values you said out loud — emails, #channels, +phones — are filled for you), and the exact HTTP/MCP request that would be sent is returned, with `missing` naming any input still needed. Preview only: this server never sends the request and never accepts credentials. A 'when …' need or several steps returns one preview per step; n8n-only steps come back as an importable n8n workflow. Running the request for real is offered separately by the Bridgecore Apify Actor (apify.com/bridgecore/bridgecore-automation-planner).

dry_run.description: Kept for compatibility; this server always previews and never sends.

inputs.description: Values for the capability's inputs by name (see `missing` in a dry run). Optional.

need.description: What should happen, in plain words. One action to run it ('text +1… saying hi'); 'when …' for a flow.

name: do

steps.description: per step: capability, request (headers masked), missing inputs, status/data/error

items.description: One step: text, kind (trigger/action), the chosen tool or a gap; reversibility = read-only (changes nothing) / reversible (undo by hand) / irreversible (sends, posts, deletes, pays — out in the world), and approval_gate (an Approve/Decline message runs first).

workflow.description: n8n workflow when a step can only run inside n8n
